content: Alembic's async env.py pattern (needed only for drivers with no sync mode, e.g. asyncpg) uses async_engine_from_config + connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations) wrapped in asyncio.run(). This project uses psycopg3, which natively supports BOTH sync and async with the same postgresql+psycopg:// URL — so Alembic's env.py can use the traditional synchronous engine_from_config/create_engine pattern directly, with no run_sync bridging needed. This is a meaningful simplification versus most current Alembic+async tutorials, which assume asyncpg.
